name: ElasticChoice
job: A plan or option picker whose selection ring draws itself on with a springy settle
visitor_action: click or tap a circle, or use arrow keys
mobile: circles wrap in an auto-fit grid
motion: ring draws on via stroke-dashoffset with an elastic overshoot, blue copy trails by 70ms, label glow fades in; deselect 0.3s ease-out (reduced-motion: instant, static duotone)
art_direction: Duotone neon: near-black navy stage, hot pink ring with glow overlapped by an electric-blue copy blended with color-dodge, Inter Tight
